title: 1971 Aeronautics and Space Highlights
description: These highlights include Mariner orbit of Mars, Interplanetary Monitoring Platform, Orbiting Solar Observatory, small scientific satellite, sounding rockets, Stratoscope 11, earth resources, aeronautics, jet noise abatement, airport runway safety, Apollo 14 and 15, and Skylab.
keywords: 1971 Aeronautics and Space Highlights, Skylab, Apollo 14, Apollo 15
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
